name: Ököritófülpös (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ököritófülpös (a blue and white shield with a monument, a flame and a wavy stripe) above the name ÖKÖRITÓFÜLPÖS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
